description: Hand-authored telemetry for the Alice incident; not live telemetry or proof of database compromise.

events.description: Alice successfully signed into Alice-Laptop from an unfamiliar source (192.0.2.40).
An unusual encoded PowerShell process ran in Alice's session on Alice-Laptop.
An SSH session from Alice-Laptop authenticated to Dev-Server using Alice's identity.
A process in the suspicious session read a plaintext configuration file containing Deployment Token on Dev-Server.
A process in the suspicious session read a plaintext configuration file containing Backup Service Token on Dev-Server.
Deployment Service accepted Deployment Token in a session associated with Dev-Server.
Backup Service accepted Backup Service Token in a session associated with Dev-Server.
Deployment Service attempted access to Customer Database; successful data access is not established.
Backup Service attempted access to Customer Database; successful data access is not established.
